titles.title: ADVERSARIES Act
Addressing Dangerous Vulnerabilities in Exports and Research to Strategic Adversaries, Regimes, and Industrial Entities of Security Concern Act
ADVERSARIES Act
A bill to require an analysis of threats posed by foreign adversary access to controlled items within the United States.
